assumptions: Exploratory lane spacing, level altitudes, demand grid and offset envelope, not certified separation rules.
Fixed independent streams with simultaneous first entries, equal demand split and same-lane/same-level groups; no switching, merging or shared terminal bottleneck.
Reuse the scenario downlink radio model; no traffic-dependent BS resource loading or new aircraft-generated interference is introduced.
Capacities are conditional planning estimates; trajectories do not enforce the policy-dependent spacing.
Offset search fixes original endpoints and uses a common post-warmup scoring window for every candidate.
The paper estimator and dashboard estimator are distinct and explicitly labeled; real-corridor runs are deterministic, not the paper stochastic geometry ensemble.
